name: Oak + Fort
known_for: Thoughtful Design for a Modern Lifestyle

prices.note: 8 regular-price, in-stock dresses of 417 listings (313 sold out, 96 marked down). Lowest Off Shoulder Open Back Mini Dress $78, highest Maxi Dress With Tassel Slit Detail $168.

sale_pattern: Online purchases at 20% off or more are final sale.
notes: About page: 'THOUGHTFUL DESIGN FOR A MODERN LIFESTYLE.' 'Opening our first OAK Studio location in Vancouver, Canada — OAK + FORT is a woman founded and led business. Valuing cost-conscious looks...' oakandfort.com is the US store (title 'OAK + FORT USA', USD).
Shipping: US orders over $100 pre-tax ship free, else $7.99; Alaska/Hawaii free over $125.
Returns: regular-price items (or under 20% off) refundable within 21 days of arrival; customer pays return shipping; 20%+ off is final sale.
Size guide: tops/dresses XXS–XL; dress feed also has numeric 0–12.
